company_info.company_description: "We install brands that give the best bang for buck to homeowners looking to reduce their electricity costs. We are also active in the community, sponsoring local junior hockey, junior netball and an upcoming young surfer in Port Macquarie.Our reviews below reflect who we are - we are honest, reliable and do a fantastic job. We are local and employ local people. Rural, residential or commercial - we're your local solar and battery experts."

reviews.review_description: Terry was very prompt at responding to our quote request, was the only quoted to actually attend in person & was able to see the site & quote appropriately to our setup & requirements.Installation went very smoothly, the 4 installers were very punctual, tidy, professional & efficient. The whole installation of 18 new panels, gateway & 3 batteries only took 6 hours.We were shown how to use the system & to understand all major components, linked into the App to monitor our system & shown how to tailor the Sigenergy system to our needs.Kathy was very efficient during the whole process, keeping us updated with dates etc. Also, on request, Terry also provided us with the link to the Origin / SolarQuotes Partner Plus energy plan after installation. Very impressed with the system purchased & the whole quoting and installation process.

I am very happy to recommend SolaXs for solar and battery installation.From the very beginning, Terry arrived on site and provided excellent advice, answering all my questions clearly and helping me choose the right system to meet my needs. Since accepting quote, government announced the rebate and stock had been hard to acquire. SolaXs kept me up to date with expected arrival dates on stock and gave me options to speed up installation if I preferred. Installation process went smoothly with the team demonstrating professionalism throughout, and completing the job efficiently, even when asked to hardwire ethernet as last minute decision on my part.They were courteous, tidy, and left the site spotless after finishing. I highly recommend SolaXs to anyone considering solar installation—they truly deliver top-notch service and quality workmanship.
All Good - Every thing worked out well took little time
The Sales Rep was very good and knowledgeable, happy to spend time with you so you can understand the quote. Installation went well, tidy work.

I am very happy with my experience with SolaXs. From the very beginning, Terry provided excellent initial advice, answering all my questions clearly and helping me choose the right system for my needs. The installation process went smoothly with the team demonstrating professionalism throughout, and completing the job efficiently. They were courteous, tidy, and left the site spotless after finishing. I highly recommend SolaXs to anyone considering solar installation—they truly deliver top-notch service and quality workmanship
Sales and quoting was clear and covered all aspects needed. Punctual, excellent communication and quality system. Connection to grid promptly organised.

Quote process was easy all companies were very happy to explain the process and to talk about changes to the system. The installation team were tidy and friendly and after installation they explained the operation of the system and arranged grid connection

Terry the owner of the business came out and quotedThe guys working for Terry were extremely professional and polite, cleaned up after themselves and were on time.Yes I was shown how the system worked and they connect my phone so that I could monitor my savings.
Terry answered all of my questions and explained why and how the difference between quotes occurred.His team arrived on time and the job was completed with no fuss and left no rubbish.
The quoting process was smooth and easy,The installers were punctual, tidy and polite.Customer service was good.

From the time I first contacted SolaX they were very polite & informative.The sales person Gary was really knowledgeable and no question was too hard to answer.The sales office kept us informed to what and when things would happen with the installation and when it came to the installers they were very friendly, and across what would happen.The work was very good - they were particular with the way they went about their tasks and tidied up when they finished. They explained how it all works and setup the app on the phone for me.
Easy process   Inspection on site , quote given and accept then solar system installed and operational within 5 weeks
Completed yesterday and in a timely manner.Tyrone, James  were both capable and professional  . Asissited by .Daniel and SteveOn TimeGrid connection was enabledQuoting process straight forward

Decided to go with Solaxs and from the start the experience was exceptionalThey arrived at 8am as agreed and were straight in to installing it. They queried about PV panels on one side of the roof under a tree line, but once advised the 2 trees were (are) to be removed, they understood the reasoning, but we appreciated their concern.One row of PV panels didn't align the the row above - looking a bit disjoined - mentioned this and they returned the next day without hassle and rearranged to all line up.The job was completed in a day (WOW) and they explained they would need to return the next day to input a code for operations. On his return, Torrens was patience and practical in explaining and answering my numerous questions.System as been running for a few weeks now and I can't wait for the next power bill so I can see the actual savings :)

From the very beginning this Company was very professional and the only company that explained the system and battery options and how they worked without the hard sell.The young men who came to install the system were very polite, hard working and tidy. They even brought their own microwave so they didn’t intrude. I honestly can’t recommend them highly enough.

The quoting period was very good, representative of the company came out to the property. The installation team were great, polite and very helpful. SolaXs also organised the grid connection. We had the inverter put in garage. Very happy with the installation and after sales service as I had a couple of questions.
Ony Supplier that come to my house and gave a competitive quote
The solarxs team completed the job professionally and on schedule..thankyou
Great service.  Prompt site visit and quoting and offered great advice tailored to my needs and corroborated the research I had already done. I can highly recommend.

The Gentleman gave me a reasonable quote which I accepted, the installation date was set and punctual, they arrived on time did the installation and cleaned up at the end.The next day they organised the grid connection, all went well.

The sales and quoting process was straightforward.The installation process was impressive , Quality material and workmanship the team arrived early and the system 18 panels and 6 kw inverter battery ready was functioning properly by lunchtime.including all regulatory requirements.The application to replace the existing meter with a smart meter is organised.
Emotional customer service.  They explained the everything and took care of everything.

I decided to purchase the new system from SolaXS of Port Macquarie. Terry arrived punctually to discuss my options and answered any queries I had in an informative manner.The price was as I expected (not dissimilar to the other quotes) and the installation date suited me better than the other firms.Installation was carried out without fuss. The installers were punctual, polite and tidy.SolaXS arranged the grid connection as well as the changeover of my existing meter to a smart meter.I would not hesitate to recommend them to anyone wishing to install a solar system.

Extremely happy.SolaXs did fantastic work. The communication of the process and dealing with the electricity companies was great for me not to deal with.The advice on sizing was important and saved me some money.And the end result and quality of the install I’m very happy with.Now running 100% off grid so far.Purchased 19 panels, 6KW inverter and 8KW batteries.

The service providers who assisted in arranging the installation for this inverter replacement and also the installers who fit the new inverter were very helpful, professional, and accommodating, and demonstrated excellent communication without any problems. I am very happy with this company and recommend them to anyone looking to have their inverter installed.
Quote was as expected, great customer service, smooth installation. Very satisfied customer. Happy to recommend publicly.

SOLAXS is a fantastic business, with excellent customer service and friendly, professional staff. I would highly recommend them. Local owners and contributes to the local community.The system itself is excellent, of great quality and I love the app that connects so you can track your usage and solar contributions.

We have had our system in for 18months now. Was great when it worked. But the inverter goes off duty regularly, and then we find that everyone at the company has gone off duty too. Couldn’t be more helpful, before they have your money. Couldn’t be less helpful after. They are just a warehouse, so no one to deal with when you need it. Avoid!!

The site visit was a very informative candid conversation and professional quote that was exactly what was discussed, not to mention no up front money to start the ball rolling and a service proposal that includes cleaning your panels!!  The day of installation was also professional - all done in 1/2 a day with no mess no fuss and good communication! A smart meter was required and they took care to arrange that as well! Very happy customer that can't recommend Solaxs enough!!

The process for getting the system installed was excellent. The installation team were on time and did an excellent job. However, I have rated the Quality of System slightly low because there have been some issues with the inverter WIFI and the SEMS Home Kit monitoring application. This has mainly manifested itself in the loss of all monitoring. It was the monitoring system that influenced my decision to use SolaXS. SolaXS have, however, put in a great deal of effort to resolve the issue resulting in a new model of Smart Meter being installed. This has not fully resolved the problem but the SolaXS team are, once again, scheduled to investigate the new issue very shortly.Their Customer Service has been excellent and I am confident that they will resolve the current problem soon. I would still be willing to recommend SolaXS to my friends.

The Sales Staff (Gary) contacted me and offered to attend my house to explain Solar Panels.  He was extremely helpful and answered all questions with immediate answers.The installation was quick and efficient.  The Head Installer (Adam) ensured that the place was left clean and tidy. All staff attending were very polite.  Adam spent time explaining the system. They were punctual.Customer Service was efficient.   Grid Connection was organized by them in a quick and timely fashion.I have no complaints and would recommend them to anyone wishing to install Solar Panels.Thank you
Everything from the first contact with sales rep, team in the office, crew that did install were awesome. Punctual, friendly, no mess left & explained everything! Super happy!

I chose the company because they took the time to meet with me, and check out the site, before I accepted their quote. Their salesperson, Gary, explained the process in detail and answered all my questions. (Being a solar novice, I had lots of questions!) No pressure from the company to accept the quote. No upfront payment. Emails answered the same day. Although the price was a little higher than my cheapest quote, I was happy to pay a little more for the excellent service. Installers arrived promptly on the day, were polite, efficient and cleaned up thoroughly afterwards. Lead sparky explained the system after installation, took the time to assist me to download the SEMs app and explain how the consumption meter worked. Totally happy with the whole process!
Great to deal with from sales through to installation and completion. Very knowledgeable staff.
Really nice to deal with. Answered calls & emails. Very professional team. Done in a morning.
Quick and easy to deal with, lead sparky was great, knew his stuff and did a good job.
They responded with 24hrs to the request for a quotation. Salesman informative and not pushy. No upfront payment. Installation guys professional and courteous.

Salesperson came out promptly and was knowledgable. Only took about 2 weeks from quote acceptance to install.Installers turned up on time on the day, got it done quickly and neatly. Cleaned up after themselves.They organised all the statutory requirements and explained what I needed to know about the system.

We got three quotes through SolarQuotes and all three were a great price.  We went with SolaXs because they were local and very through with their presentation and answers to my questions.The panels were installed in September 2021 and have functioned perfectly ever since.  The team were punctual and the installation was very quick (1/2 day) and they left the place clean and tidy.  The staff was very pleasant and personable and explained the system to me in detail before they left.The lady in the office organised the grid connection and kept us informed throughout.  Our local electrical company came not long after and installed the necessary smart meter.A few months after installation we had a minor issue with the inverter app (Goodwe) not communicating with the inverter and they came straight out to fix it the next day and left me instructions on how to fix it if it were to happen again (it happened after a large electrical storm one night).
All went well until we realised wrong quote had been implemented. Was quickly fixed to avoid unnecessary extra work.

We had our 6kw system installed about 18 months ago. I went with SolarX as per one of your recommendations.The salesman looked at our installation and advised on where to put panels. Ie. some panels on a main roof and some on a adjacent structure.When installers arrived they would not do as requested and mounted all panels on the structure, much easier of course.After installation I had trouble using the app to monitor the output. Huawei inverter would not communicate. The manager visited and could not fix. After some time and many attempts I got it working, but only if in the building, would not communicate via the web. Now I find it will not work at all.Also the inverter trips out on overvoltage at about 10-20 times a day. This is because of a voltage rise between the installation and the street and a high voltage (257V) on the incoming mains,I contacted SolarX to request data records so I could make a case to the power authority about the high voltage on the street mains. They advised the manager would contact me, but this didn't happen.Just happened to speak to a neighbour who has the same inverter, also installed by SolarX, and they said they also had trouble getting any sort of follow up from this company.Looks like I will have to have an expert solar company to sort this out for me.I really hate leaving negative reviews, but feel this company is not providing adequate follow up service.
Customer service was great and installation went smoothly. I was very happy with the company I chose.

The sales and quoting process was friendly and informative, without being pushy.The company kept me up to date with proposed installation date and flexible with making changes.The installation was professional, quick and tidy.  I was informed about the next steps and my questions answered.Happy to recommend.

Such a great experience with SolaXs. From the quote to the switch on and after sale service when the app crashed. Terry was flexible and fitted around my availability with the quoting process. Was honest and answered all my questions and suggested some websites to visit so I could learn more about the systems. Install was organised to fit around when I could be home and the team persevered through a wet and drizzly day with a slippery roof. Adam helped me with the app and then Kathy made sure everything was switched over with my supplier!Highly recommend SolaXs for your solar install and after sale service.
sales and quoting was very punctualinstallation was very tidy and punctualcustomer service organised everything
The whole experience was very professionally handled from initial discussion with sales rep through to installation
Great people to deal with, friendly and efficient.I’m thinking now of batteries as well and if I do it’ll be these people I’ll be dealing with.

The quoting system went as planned (the representative turned up as expected and was knowledgeable about the product). From start to finish this was a perfectly professional job.Quoting was simple and the sales agent visited the property promptly armed with all necessary information.(Two other quoters did not bother coming to inspect the property)The installation went very well despite the small difficulty posed by a thick concrete slab in an awkward spot; the team found a good way around.Instructions were delivered professionally and follow-up queries dealt with promptly.I highly recommend this company.

Thank you for the no pressure professional work and advice that your team gave us. Well done 10 out of 10

All I have had to do is forward a copy of my latest electricity account to Solaxs, the rest has been taken care of. The installers were friendly, efficient and left no mess behind. They painstakingly took us through the procedures and answered all our questions. They employ young local youths which is a plus in a regional area. I have worked for a builder and it had always been very difficult having solar connected and the correct paperwork in place but Solaxs took care of it all. If you live on the NSW mid north coast do yourself a favour and use Solaxs, hands down the best I have dealt with for solar installation.
Friendly, knowledgeable and very efficient installers. Mindful of the social distancing requirements. No hesitation in recommending Solaxs..
